//: Capability manifest for <Heatmap> — svelte-pure-admin. Scope: the pa-heatmap block (grid container + data-level cells). `levels` is a data list rendered as pa-heatmap__cell[data-level] children (the oracle/keen shape); svelte also accepts a hand-authored <HeatmapCell> `children` snippet when levels is omitted, out of scope here. `columns` drives the inline grid-template-columns (svelte prop `cols`). variant is success|danger only (the two CSS-backed cell ramps). The separate pa-heatmap-legend / pa-heatmap__legend* block is a different component (HeatmapLegend.svelte) and out of scope.
